summary: GD Culture Group Ltd filed a prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 259,301,306 shares at $0.021 per share, raising ~$5.45M gross. The shares are priced at a ~0.48% premium to the prior day's $0.0209 close. Univest Securities acts as exclusive placement agent receiving 7% cash fee. The offering is non-dilutive relative to market, with delivery expected June 24, 2026, subject to customary closing. No special situation; this is ordinary equity financing by the issuer.
